channel.title: Worth the Fee
channel.description: Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you.

item.title: When is the Amex Platinum annual fee charged, and can you get it refunded?
item.description: The $895 fee is reported to post on the first statement. Amex refunds it only if you close within 30 days after that statement's closing date.

item.title: Does the Amex Platinum charge foreign transaction fees, and how well does it work abroad?
item.description: The Amex Platinum has no foreign transaction fee, but Amex is taken in fewer places abroad than Visa or Mastercard, and cash from an ATM is costly.

item.title: What credit score do you need for the Chase Sapphire Preferred?
item.description: Chase publishes no minimum score for the Sapphire Preferred. Named sources report 670 to 700 and up, and the score is only one of several checks.

item.title: How does the Chase Sapphire Reserve StubHub credit work, and what counts?
item.description: The Reserve pays back up to $150 per half-year on StubHub and viagogo tickets through 2027, after a one-time activation. Unused credit does not roll over.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Dick's Sporting Goods, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 9% on November 22, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Gift cards, warranties, services, three brands and bulk orders are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Old Navy, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 2% on November 22, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards, Joseph Altuzarra items and the part paid with reward points are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Chewy, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 4% on November 22, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Prescriptions, flea and tick products, gift cards and repeat Autoship orders are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Wayfair, and what is excluded?
item.description: Not on the day checked. On November 22, 2026, Rakuten's Wayfair page showed No Cash Back, with no rate, terms or exclusions.

item.title: What are the Sapphire Reserve credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?
item.description: The Reserve lists about $2,400 a year in credits, but most people would use $300 to $900 of it. Add up your own number against the $795 fee.

item.title: What are the Amex Platinum credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?
item.description: On paper the 11 main Amex Platinum credits total $2,994 a year. Your real number is only the ones you would have paid for anyway.

item.title: Is the Amex Platinum referral offer higher or lower than the public offer?
item.description: It can be higher, lower or the same. Amex sets an offer for each applicant, so compare the number each route shows you before you accept.

item.title: How do Amex Platinum purchase protection, return protection and extended warranty work?
item.description: Amex Platinum covers new items for 90 days up to $10,000, refunds refused returns up to $300 an item, and adds up to a year of warranty.

item.title: What travel insurance does the Amex Platinum include, and what does it leave out?
item.description: Amex Platinum covers trip delay up to $500, trip cancellation up to $10,000 and lost bags up to $3,000 a person. It does not pay medical bills.

item.title: What counts toward the Chase Sapphire Reserve's $300 travel credit, and when does it reset?
item.description: Any purchase Chase codes as travel counts, from flights to tolls and parking. It resets each account anniversary year and earns no points.

item.title: How do purchase protection and extended warranty work on the Chase Sapphire Preferred?
item.description: Purchase protection covers theft or damage for 120 days, up to $500 per item. Extended warranty adds one year to a warranty of three years or less.

item.title: How does Rakuten cash back work on Black Friday and Cyber Week 2026?
item.description: The same way as any other day, but rates move more. Activate before filling the cart, and expect payment in February or May 2027.

item.title: Does the Amex Platinum do anything for golfers?
item.description: Very little directly. The US Amex Platinum has no free rounds, green fee credit or tee time perk, but its hotel credit and lounges can help a golf trip.

item.title: Amex Platinum or Chase Sapphire Reserve for a once-a-year Hawaii trip?
item.description: For one Hawaii trip a year the Sapphire Reserve fits better: lower fee, a simple $300 travel credit and 1:1 Hyatt transfers.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Samsung.com, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 2% on November 21, 2026, phones included. It is paid only on what is left after trade-in credit. Employee Perks orders earn nothing.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Adidas, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: up to 6% on November 21, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Samba, Gazelle, Spezial and EVO SL earn 2%. Collaborations and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Lowe's, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: up to 2% on November 21, 2026 (usual rate 1%), with 1% on appliances. Lumber, decking, installations and gift cards are excluded.

item.title: Does Rakuten give cash back at Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack, and what is excluded?
item.description: On November 21, 2026, Rakuten showed No Cash Back at Nordstrom and 2% at Nordstrom Rack. Gift cards and five brands are excluded at the Rack.

item.title: How does the Amex Platinum hotel credit work?
item.description: Up to $300 back each half-year, $600 a year, on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts, Hotel Collection or Airbnb Luxe stays booked through Amex Travel.

item.title: What are the Amex Platinum Oura and Equinox credits worth if you would not buy them anyway?
item.description: Close to $0. The $200 Oura credit still leaves about $149 to pay for a ring, and the $300 Equinox credit covers only an app or part of a gym fee.

item.title: What credit score and income do you need for the Amex Platinum?
item.description: Amex publishes no minimum score or income. Guides suggest good to excellent credit, and Amex can show a decision before any hard inquiry.

item.title: What rental car status and insurance come with the Amex Platinum?
item.description: Status with Hertz, Avis and National after enrolling, plus secondary damage cover up to $75,000. A paid add-on makes the cover primary.

item.title: Is the Amex Platinum a charge card or a credit card, and how does Pay Over Time work?
item.description: It works like a charge card with no preset limit, plus a Pay Over Time feature that lets eligible charges carry a balance with interest.

item.title: How does the Amex Platinum Walmart+ credit work, and is the membership worth having?
item.description: The card refunds a monthly Walmart+ membership, $12.95 plus tax, up to $155 a year. The annual plan earns no credit. Worth having if you use it.

item.title: How does the Amex Platinum Lululemon credit work, and what counts?
item.description: Up to $75 back each quarter, $300 a year, at US lululemon stores and lululemon.com after you enroll. Outlets and gift cards are excluded.

item.title: Can you upgrade a Sapphire Preferred to a Reserve or downgrade to a Freedom card, and what happens to points and the bonus?
item.description: Yes, after about a year with the card. A product change keeps the account but pays no welcome bonus, and a Freedom card cannot transfer points.
